snippet.title: Arizona Sunshine - Reveal Trailer [ESRB]
snippet.description:
Welcome to the sun-kissed, zombie state of Arizona.

Sharpen your machete, reload your shotgun, and bring your friends. The award-winning Arizona Sunshine® series brings explosive third-person, sun-baked co-op action to players everywhere.

Survive a chaotic, dark-humored apocalypse built on the signature brutal gameplay of the series and the story of Arizona Sunshine® VR 2, where every encounter can spiral out of control.

Play as Sunny, a lonely but dark-humored survivor travelling across Arizona with his loyal dog Buddy. A story of survival, friendship, and keeping sanity in the apocalypse.

Grab a friend for split-screen or online co-op and fight through massive zombie hordes with shotguns, machetes, flamethrowers, and more, with Buddy fully playable as a co-op companion for the first time.

Arizona Sunshine® is reimagined in third-person with over-the-top combat, customization, dark humour, and co-op chaos.

Wishlist now:
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019858
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9n4h0qwg23h0
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4308420/Arizona_Sunshine/
GOG: Coming soon
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/arizona-sunshine-4576c8
Nintendo Switch: Coming soon
